solution:
"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/smallest-number-with-all-set-bits/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

3370. Smallest Number With All Set Bits

You are given a positive number n.

Return the smallest number x greater than or equal to n, such that the binary representation of x contains only set bits.

Example 1:

Input: n = 5
Output: 7
Explanation:
The binary representation of 7 is "111".

Example 2:

Input: n = 10
Output: 15
Explanation:
The binary representation of 15 is "1111".

Example 3:

Input: n = 3
Output: 3
Explanation:
The binary representation of 3 is "11".

Constraints:

    1 <= n <= 1000
"""


class Solution:
    def smallestNumber(self, n: int) -> int:
        # The smallest number with all set bits >= n is a number of the form 2^k - 1 for some k
        # Find the smallest k such that 2^k - 1 >= n
        k = 1
        while (1 << k) - 1 < n:
            k += 1
        return (1 << k) - 1


sol = Solution()

print(sol.smallestNumber(5))  # 7

assert sol.smallestNumber(5) == 7
assert sol.smallestNumber(10) == 15
assert sol.smallestNumber(3) == 3

assert sol.smallestNumber(1) == 1
assert sol.smallestNumber(2) == 3
assert sol.smallestNumber(7) == 7
assert sol.smallestNumber(8) == 15
assert sol.smallestNumber(15) == 15
assert sol.smallestNumber(16) == 31
assert sol.smallestNumber(31) == 31
assert sol.smallestNumber(32) == 63
assert sol.smallestNumber(63) == 63
assert sol.smallestNumber(64) == 127
assert sol.smallestNumber(1000) == 1023
assert sol.smallestNumber(999) == 1023
